def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    anchors = {r: row[0] for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0}
    # Select the shortest repeating period consistent with all observed bands.
    period = next(p for p in range(1, h + 1)
                  if all(anchors[a] == anchors[b]
                         for a in anchors for b in anchors
                         if a < b and (a - b) % p == 0))
    phases = {r % period: color for r, color in anchors.items()}
    # Fill missing phases by repeating the observed phase order cyclically.
    known = sorted(phases)
    if known:
        for i in range(period):
            if i not in phases:
                phases[i] = phases[min(known, key=lambda k: (k-i) % period)]
    return [[phases[r % period]] * w for r in range(h)]
